name: Honda Super Cub C125
engine: 125 cc air-cooled single, fuel injected, four-speed semi-auto
intro: The modern Super Cub. Simple to work on. 2020-2021 bikes had a reflector recall, and Honda has an emissions recall on 2019-2024 bikes.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls and ask a Honda dealer too. 2020-2021 C125s are in recall 21V382 (rear reflector). Honda also has an emissions recall on all 2019-2024 C125s for the fuel system.

F: The C125 has an automatic clutch. Don't hunt for a clutch cable to adjust.

recalls.what: Rear reflector lens may be too dim to meet the lighting standard.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the rear reflector free.
